# Cannot compute: the CN code is unresolved

I cannot give a definitive embedded-emissions figure. The declaration contains **conflicting CN codes**, and the ruleset requires a single, confirmed CN code to select the default SEE.

## The conflict

| Source in declaration | CN code | Good | Default SEE (India) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Goods description | 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods with indentations (ribbed rebar) | 4.27 tCO2e/t |
| CN-code field | 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen | 2.53 tCO2e/t |

The two codes map to different factors, so the choice changes the result substantially. Picking one would be an assumption, and the rules say not to estimate.

## Inputs checked

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | ❌ **Not resolved.** The declaration gives 7214 20 00 and 7201. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | ✅ India is listed for both candidate codes. |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 1,500 t |

## Missing input

1. **A single, confirmed CN code for the imported good.** The declarant needs to correct the declaration so the description and the CN-code field agree. The ribbed-rebar description points to 7214 20 00, but that must be confirmed by the declarant, not inferred.

Once the CN code is confirmed, the calculation is: confirmed SEE (India) × 1,500 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
